investigations.question: After a voter is removed and then re-added by committed configuration changes, which code path lets a Node.Propose invocation on that re-added voter reach a decision (forward to the leader, be appended, or return an error), while the same leader stays in place?
investigations.hypothesis: node.run() keeps its proposal gate armed only as a side effect of observing a leader change and disarms it when the local member is removed from the configuration; a re-admission does not re-arm it, so while no leader change is observed the member's MsgProp traffic (Node.Propose and Node.ProposeConfChange) stays pending on the non-nil n.propc channel instead of being forwarded, appended, or rejected with an error.
